content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ECHS Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ECHS Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ECHS Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available - 2 for Medical Officer, 1 for Clerk, 1 for Female Attendant and 1 for Peon.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 23-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the ECHS recruitment is 23rd September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for various posts including Medical Officer, Clerk, Female Attendant, and Peon in this ECHS recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this ECHS recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their filled application forms to the official address as mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The Medical Officer post offers a minimum salary of Rs. 95,000/- per month. Other posts also have attractive salary packages as per their eligibility.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: For the Clerk post, candidates should be Graduates or possess Class I Clerical trade (Armed Forces) with a minimum of 5 years of experience and computer qualification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this ECHS recruitment. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these ECHS posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these ECHS posts will primarily involve an Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview scheduled for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The interview for the ECHS recruitment is scheduled to be held on 28th September 2026. Candidates should be prepared for the interview on this date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of ECHS?
faq.answer: The official website of Ex Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) is www.echs.gov.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information and to download the application form.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the posts released by ECHS?
faq.answer: The job type for the posts released by ECHS in this recruitment is contractual. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the contract agreement.
